quest.title: Radiant Sakura
quest.description: In Raiden Makoto's remnant realm of consciousness, Ei and the Shogun Puppet engage in an endless fight. For Inazuma, and also for Ei herself, you wish to lend a hand — as you once did — to help her get through this sore test.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x600, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Light x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine and meet Yae Miko

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Someone's not in the best of moods... Let me guess, you're all tangled up in another situation and need me to unravel it for you?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I hope you realize how lucky you are. If it was anyone else, I don't think I'd have the patience to keep greeting them with a smile after the first few times.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...But you're always smiling!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: That was a figure of speech, do you understand? Nitpicking my turns of phrase, the sheer audacity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, get to the point...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, yeah! Something really big's happened! It's Ei, she... she...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Yae Miko about everything that has happened...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh, okay, I see. So Ei's decided to palm Inazuma off onto the humans, while she goes off on her own to fight a fierce battle that doesn't even have an end date...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Impossibly stubborn, jumps straight to the most extreme course of action imaginable, presumes her sheer will can see her through, despite a near-impossible goal that requires nothing short of the very peak of her abilities... Yes, that sounds like Ei, alright.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: You know as well as I do that she's always been like this. Why start fretting about it now?

choices.text: This duel is more serious than anything up till now.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Rushed into it without thinking... Hehe, well put. Ah, she acts like such a child sometimes.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: So, you seem to be under the impression that I am able to offer some sort of help? Who gave you that idea?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is she playing dumb? She's doing this on purpose for sure!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Aha, you're learning, little one. But really, the truth of the matter is that I don't know much more about Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness than you do.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: All I know is that it's the foundation of the Sacred Sakura, and from what I have heard it's a little different from Ei's "Plane of Euthymia."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Because Raiden Makoto is no longer alive?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Not just because of that. The nature of the space itself is different in some way... But I can only speculate. You're the ones who have actually been there, so you tell me — what was it like?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Anyway, we needn't worry about the details too much — it'll just be a little difficult to explain things later on, that's all.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: First things first. Follow me to the entrance.

choices.text: She rushed into it without thinking.

talks.objective: Return to the entrance to the secret realm

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: How can this be?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: You have returned... But how were you able to get back in? And... how come you have not changed at all in all these years...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All these years? ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: This is a duel to remember.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: It is as if we have returned to the moment when the laws of eternity were first established. Your will today is as strong as it was back then.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Over countless battles, not once have you lost, and never have you shown the slightest hesitation.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Had I made all enemies of eternity stand against you, you still would not have wavered.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: For your firm commitment to enforcing the rules, you have my admiration, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: You bring honor to the title of "Guardian of Eternity."

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Now these two return once more to this space. An inevitability of fate, perhaps.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Then let this be our final duel, the conclusion to that which began 500 years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Final duel? So you're finally willing to...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Stand back, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you going to put an end to all this?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm going to be the start of something new.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Now then, I always have my ways. It's just a question of how crafty I need to be...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: To the outsider, the realm of consciousness is a very abstract concept. Luckily, I'm Ei's familiar, so I can sense her rough whereabouts.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: In other words, even though I can't pinpoint the exact spatial location of this realm, I can still send you to where Ei is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it's abstract, but has a location, but you don't know where it is, but you can still send us there... what?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Yes, no need to try and understand it. Let me put this simply: Right now, she is surrounded by chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Everything is turbulent and disordered... If you try to force your way in, you could be swept away by a giant wave that sets you down in an unknown corner of space-time.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: This is precisely why when entering the Plane of Euthymia, it's much safer if you place your consciousness in a physical object first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Alright, well Paimon's staying here, then. You two can go in!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Suit yourself. Worst-case scenario, all we stand to lose is Ei, so what's the big deal?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You... Ugh! Paimon's had it up to here with both of you! Fine, Paimon's coming too...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh? Well if you're quite sure, then of course. Now, I shall send you on your way.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hmm? I say...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is it?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh, nothing. It just seems extraordinarily chaotic, that's all. My suspicions have been confirmed.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: By the way... Remember to focus constantly on your heartfelt wishes when you enter inside.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Only a strong enough will can prevent you from being swallowed by the giant waves of abstract space. Only if you are strong enough can I deliver you to the right destination.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Well then. The door is open. Hop on in.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: I'll stay outside and provide what stability I can. I'll be ready to respond if anything happens.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: #...I'm placing my god in your capable hands, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: For my sake, and for Inazuma's, please... bring her back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miko, you'd better know what you're doing...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We will not fail.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: That's enough chatter. Get to work!

choices.text: Paimon, you're not gonna abandon me, are you?

talks.objective: Force your way into the realm

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After leaving the realm of consciousness and returning to the shrine, you relay everything to Yae Miko...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: So the Ei of the present planted the Sacred Sakura in the realm of consciousness, and it took root in the Inazuma of the past...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: No matter what you make of it, it's quite incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: All of this is thanks to Makoto's power. Her understanding of eternity is much more profound than mine.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Eternity is a concept intimately connected with time. When you begin to touch on eternity, the concept of time becomes murky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I saw wonderful things inside that place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Time was moving forward and backward at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: A place where time is meaningless and cannot be understood with ordinary logic... So, that was the "turbulence" I was sensing.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Perhaps that is the reason why you were able to return precisely to this point in time without any problems.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: And yet, that sense of disorderliness has now completely disappeared.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I don't fully understand yet. But my intuition tells me that the reason for everything... it's that seed.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm, well I'm not convinced that it was Makoto's power alone...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I know what you mean. Perhaps a higher{RUBY#[S]Istaroth} power really was involved in all of this. But whatever the explanation, her solution is what saved us all.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Without the Sacred Sakura, Inazuma would likely have been completely swallowed up centuries ago by that disaster and the filth.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I know you've always perceived there was something special about the Sacred Sakura. But to me, it has always been there.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: You've tried in the past to prove to me that there is a connection between the Sacred Sakura and Makoto's consciousness. But unfortunately, you never did persuade me, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: No, but I understand why now. It was because the Sacred Sakura hadn't even been planted then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm, but don't you think that tree looked a lot different than how it does now?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The Sacred Sakura is within my purview at the shrine, so obviously I get to prune it exactly how I like it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Now we see who's pulling the strings...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I'm joking. That tree has been through a lot since it first sprouted. We have the loving care of kitsune over the ages to thank for how it appears today.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: And obviously I played my part, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It's fair to say that very little time passed between the moment you came out of that realm and the moment you re-entered it. But in that same time, centuries of battling took place on the inside, did it not?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Traveler, if I'm guessing correctly... You were repeating your wishes to yourself in your mind, weren't you?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: At that time, I could sense Ei's whereabouts, but I also sensed anomalies in the flow of time within that space.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Suffice to say, time added a whole new dimension to our search. Simply establishing a location was not sufficient.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Fortunately, your will was strong enough that the turbulence carried you to the moment in time most likely to be the intersection of all that you were wishing for.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The flow of turbulence may well have been influenced by Makoto. But it took everyone's efforts combined to ultimately help Ei. So this time, it looks like thanks are due to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean... it wasn't by chance that we ended up at the final duel? We were always meant to be there to witness what was going to happen?

choices.text: Perhaps this is what the Shogun meant by...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I thought that the flow of time was the same on the inside and the outside. So it was a great shock to me when the Traveler re-appeared.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: My first thought was, "Has a great disaster befallen Inazuma?"

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: But it turned out you had come to rescue me... You came for my sake, to help me reach the best possible outcome.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: You two have my thanks. You have done much for me, and I will never forget it.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Ei, how are you feeling now?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: My body has fully recovered, and the Shogun's will no longer fights against me.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Always thrilled to hear you're in good health. But I was really asking about your emotions. Have you managed to calm down?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: After all, you saw Makoto in there, didn't you?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I only heard her voice. I wouldn't say I saw her...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I'll be fine. It brought a few things back, of course. But I've made my decision to move forward.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I have to say, this has reminded me once again just how brilliant Makoto was. She predicted all the ways in which Inazuma's future could unfold all the way back then.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: She even factored my immaturity into her plan.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It's all thanks to her that Inazuma lived to see this day.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I just planted a seed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your will and hers were both indispensable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It was thanks to everything you did that you got to see her again. That's amazing!

choices.text: The final act might be a simple one.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just because the cause and effect ended up a bit back-to-front...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: #...Thank you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Today, at long last, you and Inazuma finally emerge from the shadows cast by the events of centuries past.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Makoto and you are Inazuma's past and future, and both are indispensable.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It's rare to hear such comforting words from you. I graciously accept them.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh, come on, you only think it's rare because you never used to listen to a word I say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Makoto said the exact same thing.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Great minds think alike, hmm? I wonder, does that qualify me to, maybe, take the position of Shogun for a couple of days?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Actually, no — forget that. Far more trouble than it's worth.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: We will have to end the frivolities there. There is much work to be done.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: The Shogun and I will closely review the Inazuma of today to find out where things currently stand. Then, we will give careful consideration to the future.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: After that... I will abolish the Sakoku Decree.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? That's huge news!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I am no longer pursuing an eternity defined by stasis. In which case, there is no further need to keep the nation under lock and key.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I don't doubt that many challenges lie ahead for Inazuma...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But out of those challenges will be born new opportunities.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I'm looking forward to it.

choices.text: But getting there was the result of countless efforts coming together.
But Ei, you made a crucial contribution, too.

talks.objective: Force your way into the realm
Speak to Ei and get up to speed with the situation
Witness the end of the long battle

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: This is the end. You have won.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: I believed you were incapable of transcending the past. But it seems my belief was baseless and I underestimated your spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: But a will that cannot be eroded has no way to embrace the future.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: You need not worry about the future, and you aren't alone.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I know your power more than anyone else. Had I relied upon my strength alone, I would have lost this duel for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Yet my reason for fighting redefined my martial prowess and redrew my limits. I now carry the gaze of the myriad of expectant eyes that look to the light in the heavens.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: And whenever I think of this, I feel something stirring within Musou Isshin.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: The blade that I inherited from Makoto seems to be trying to guide me... to encourage me.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: I noticed it also. Just now, in the heat of battle, it seemed to unleash a new and unfamiliar power.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: This power is beyond the limits of my understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: This blade belonged to Mak{RUBY#[S]the previous Shogun}oto. Perhaps it can only respond to me with its full power when I truly understand and believe in her.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: When I clasped Musou Isshin in my hands, I had the feeling that she was by my side once again.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It was at once a familiar feeling and a strange one... Makoto barely wielded a blade in her life, and yet her blade brings me closer to her.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: You have my approval.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Your present will is not the product of erosion. I shall no longer stop you from attempting to modify the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: From this day forth, this body will remain your assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I won't design any more rules that can never be changed.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: You used to represent my past, but from today onward, you are me.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Makoto never saw me as a fearless weapon. Likewise, I should not regard you as a mere tool.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: ...Heh, you truly have changed. I suppose this is what humans call "growth."

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: I understand. I shall become your shadow, just as you were once Makoto's shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: The duties I perform will not change.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: But as a warrior, I look forward to the chance to fight like this again in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Do you say this because you have not yet reconciled yourself with your defeat?

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: It was simply a new experience for me. One that is worth reliving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you finished fighting, then? Like, for real this time?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Musou Isshin is glowing?

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: Hello Ei, and greetings, those who have come to bear witness.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I am Raiden Makoto, the previous Electro Archon, who failed in my duties and left you all to pick up the pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Makoto...?

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I'm so happy. You've come so far. I always knew you would make it here in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I left a faint fragment of my will in Musou Isshin, so that in the moment that you unleashed its full power, I too would be released.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: A convoluted way to reach you, but... Well, you held such deeply entrenched views at the time that you wouldn't have listened to a word I said.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: There was no time to wait for you to have a change of heart. Please forgive me... All I could do was find some way to wait until you came to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: But you never mentioned this to me...

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: Everything happened so suddenly... I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I've always felt terrible for having to entrust Inazuma to you all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I should have been the one to impart these ideas to you a little at a time, to dissuade you from your pursuit of stillness.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Did you know what was about to happen in Khaenri'ah?

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: I had some sense of it. That place... was not somewhere that any archon could afford to ignore.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: In my present form, I can no longer perceive time. I don't know how long we have been separated before this reunion, and I don't know what Inazuma has experienced in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: But I know that this must have been an extremely arduous journey for you... and I'm sure you must have wanted to shed tears many times along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...Don't look down on me.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: See, you admit it.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: It was with this possibility in mind that I left a parting gift for you... something to soothe Inazuma's pain.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: Here, take it. Before my last shred of consciousness fades away.

dialogues.speaker: Makoto
dialogues.text: But it is you who must take the most important step...

talks.objective: Witness the beginning of the dream
Talk to Ei and Yae Miko

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: The time our duels took to fight was long enough to witness the rise and fall of nations.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: The energy they consumed, great enough to vaporize the oceans and turn day into night.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: And the will they demanded, sufficient to penetrate minds and crush dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Yet, you have endured.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I will endure forever.
